requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

413-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
413-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

240-5470-6495-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-5470-6495-8201.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1445-4871-6351-8249.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6351-8249.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2393-4279-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-6794--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1753-2023-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4770-4785-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3698-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
3698-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 5.

147-728-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-728-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-728-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

7675-7676-8104.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Misty Rainforest.
7675-7676-8104.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Misty Rainforest.
When Misty Rainforest enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Misty Rainforest by paying 1 life, tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

4053-4247-7134--145.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3330-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3330-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4716-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4716-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

225-3129-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

475-5641-7743-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-5641-7743-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

206-3010-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3010-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2060-2713-5140-7741.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-5140-7741.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1189-5759-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
1189-5759-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Screaming Nemesis indestructible using Eldrazi Monument.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
1189-5759-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

2921-4681-5170-6772.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2034-5170-6132-6772.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1558-1671-3875-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-3875-4231-6753.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1170-1329-2478-7297.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

628-5231-7217.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Aang

373-1525-5361-7115-7117.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland card in hand.
You have not resolved either a firebending ability, a waterbending ability, and/or an airbending ability this turn.
373-1525-5361-7115-7117.description:
Cast any spell by paying {0} due to Fist of Suns and Aang, Master of Elements.
Toph triggers, earthbending a land.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1, and repeat from step 1 as able.
373-1525-5361-7115-7117.notes: You need to have both an Avatar Aang and an Aang, Master of Elements on the battlefield. This combo only reduces the mana cost of spells to {0} - it doesn't negate additional costs or targets those spells may require.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1251-3259-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2097-2557-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2097-2557-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Jolene and Parallel Lives.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
2097-2557-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

654-2692-2893-3875.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.
When the basic land enters, Amulet of Vigor, Tireless Provisioner and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

480-2292-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

549-1978-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 3 or greater.
549-1978-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat

2173-3944-4699-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

301-1099-6461.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

4285-6790.manaNeeded: {R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
4285-6790.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand.
4285-6790.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pyromancer's Goggles by tapping it, adding {R}.
Cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Pyromancer's Goggles triggers, copying Increasing Vengeance, with the copy targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Resolve the copy of Increasing Vengeance, creating a copy of Increasing Vengeance targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Repeat step 5.

586-1796-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

394-1445-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-1445-4871-5147.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

222-527-1115-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

933-1558-2397-4231-4979.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Gilded Goose.
When Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

2430-3415-4515-5218.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by discarding Sun Ce.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Sun Ce and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Cast Sun Ce from exile by discarding Petals of Insight.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Petals of Insight and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Sun Ce enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight from exile by discarding Sun Ce.
Repeat from step 2.

513-1741-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
513-1741-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Cloud of Faeries to your hand from the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Peregrine Drake to your hand from the battlefield.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.
If you control a land that can tap to produce at least {2}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1995-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Gauntlets of Light attached to Bloom Tender.
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
1995-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {3}{W}.
Activate Bloom Tender by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1912-2816-4360.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Greenweaver Druid.
Greenweaver Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1912-2816-4360.description:
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Greenweaver Druid by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1525-2396-4298-4651.notablePrerequisites:
Phyresis and Ophidian Eye attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
1525-2396-4298-4651.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
